name: Taxi Plate
summary: Live taxi plate, vehicle, pickup, and trip timing on the glasses.
description: Reads supported taxi notifications on the phone, keeps the active ride state, and shows pickup or trip timing through native Rokid Nexus cards and PINs.
author: Zhilin

listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## About

Keep the useful part of an active taxi ride in view: plate, vehicle, pickup status, waiting time, and remaining trip time. Taxi Plate reads enabled provider notifications on the phone and publishes native Nexus cards and compact PINs to the glasses.

## Providers and privacy

A Yandex Go adapter is included. Additional providers can be added with validated JSON adapter bundles from the phone settings. Notification access is granted explicitly in Android; diagnostics stay local unless you export them yourself.

The plugin is phone-only. Rokid Nexus owns the glasses connection and rendering, so no separate glasses APK or Hi Rokid authorization is required.
